news.title: SiMa.ai融资1.5亿美元，估值达14.5亿美元，加速Physical AI规模化
news.snippet: [SiMa.ai获1.5亿美元融资，估值14.5亿美元，将规模化Physical AI并扩展Pale业务。]
news.raw_snippet:
The company said the funding would support expansion of Palette Neat, its agentic software environment for Physical AI, alongside development of next-generation processors designed to deliver 1,000 dense TOPS of computing performance. [...] SiMa.ai has secured US$150 million in Series C financing, pushing its valuation to US$1.45 billion as the semiconductor company accelerates development of technology designed to bring artificial intelligence into robots, vehicles and drones.

The investment takes total funding to US$500 million and positions the company to expand its purpose-built Physical AI platform as demand grows for computing systems capable of running advanced AI outside conventional data centres. [...] Fidelity Management and Research Company and Amplify co-led the round, with backing from Alter Venture Partners, Dell Technologies Capital, Maverick Capital, +ND Capital, Point72 and StepStone Group. New investors included AllianceBernstein, Baron Capital, J.P. Morgan and the State of Michigan.

news.title: TikTok CEO：AI三年内将带来重大科学突破
news.snippet: [TikTok CEO周受资预计，人工智能将在未来三年内催生重大科学突破，有望在药物、材料领域展现AGI潜力。]
news.raw_snippet:
SINGAPORE — TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew expects artificial intelligence to drive major scientific breakthroughs within the next three years, transforming a broad range of sectors.

"In the next two to three years, we're going to have a real scientific breakthrough: physics, biotech, chemistry, material science, because of AI. It's very, very, very possible," Chew said at the DBS Asia Future Forward Conference in Singapore on Monday. [...] Chew highlighted the accelerating pace of technological development, particularly in scientific research, arguing that the longer-term implications of AI could be far greater than currently anticipated. [...] He described scientific discovery as one of the most promising applications of AI, even as the technology increasingly reshapes TikTok's operations, from content creation and recommendations to search and moderation.

Chew cautioned that AI's growing capabilities would require stronger safeguards, particularly as autonomous systems become more widely adopted.
